## Why

The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-131821-14b9, project ork, item S544: to confirm the red run it had to trace `HEAD:internal/cache/cache.go` by hand, because a `go test -overlay` run against the base version needs a copy of the file in the reviewer's temp dir, and the reviewer cannot write a 700-line file. S545's reviewer reported the same thing (adj 559). It could not run the revert mutations under read-only rules and relied on the implementer's table.

Owner decision, 2026-11-25: ork code does the copying. For each changed Go file, ork writes the base version (`git show BASE:path`) and an overlay JSON into the reviewer's temp dir, and puts a ready `go test -overlay` command in the reviewer brief. The reviewer prompt also carries the `go test -overlay` probe recipe (adj 560), so a reviewer who may write its temp dir (S510) can add a probe test. The slice also removes the dead `Bash(adj find*)` grant from the local spec-check allowlist, since adj has no `find` command (S559 run ork-20261125-163840-c68e finding 1; owner chose "Fold into S554").

## Failing tests

- TestBaseOverlaySectionForChangedGoFile (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): the reviewer brief of a round with these fake git routes: merge-base `base`; changed names `internal/x/x.go`, `internal/x/x_test.go` and `README.md`; `git show base:internal/x/x.go` returns known bytes. The brief holds a `## Base overlays` section with exactly one entry, for `internal/x/x.go`. The file `TMPDIR/base/internal/x/x.go` holds those exact bytes. `TMPDIR/overlay-1.json` parses to `{"Replace": {"WORKTREE/internal/x/x.go": "TMPDIR/base/internal/x/x.go"}}`. The section names the command `go -C WORKTREE test -overlay TMPDIR/overlay-1.json ./internal/x`. No entry exists for the `_test.go` file or the README.
- TestBaseOverlayNewFileMapsToEmpty (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): a changed Go file that `git show BASE:path` cannot read (new in the slice) gets an overlay whose `Replace` value is `""`. The section says the file is new in this slice and that the overlay hides it. No base copy is written.
- TestBaseOverlayNoSectionWithoutGoFiles (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): a diff with no non-test Go file gives the reviewer no `## Base overlays` section and writes no files.
- TestBaseOverlayAdvisory (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): when the changed-path read fails, or `git show` fails with an error other than "path not in base", the run still reaches awaiting approval. The reviewer section says the overlay check is incomplete and tells the reviewer to trace the base version with `git show` itself.
- TestBaseOverlayListLimit (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): with 25 changed Go files the section lists 20 and says 5 were left out.
- TestBaseOverlayOnlyForTheReviewer (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): the gate and architect briefs of the same round have no `## Base overlays` section.
- TestReviewerPromptCarriesTheProbeRecipe (`internal/roles/roles_test.go`): the reviewer prompt names `-overlay`, a probe test file kept in `{{temp_dir}}`, the overlay JSON shape `{"Replace": ...}` and one plain `go -C {{worktree}} test -overlay` command. ## Implement

1. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, split `branchPaths` into a helper that returns the merge base and the changed paths, and make `branchPaths` call it. The merge base is the same `git merge-base BASEBRANCH HEAD` that Direction and the decision-paths check use. Behaviour of `branchPaths` does not change.
2. Add `internal/engine/baseoverlay.go` with `func (e *Engine) baseOverlaySection(ctx, rec runrec.Record, tmpDir string) *BriefSection`.
   - From the helper in step 1, keep the changed paths that end in `.go` and not in `_test.go`.
   - For each, in sorted order and capped at 20, run `git -C WORKTREE show MERGEBASE:path` through `gitRead`. On success, write the bytes to `TMPDIR/base/path` (mode 0o600, parent dirs 0o700). Write `TMPDIR/overlay-N.json` as `{"Replace": {"WORKTREE/path": "TMPDIR/base/path"}}`. If the path is not in the base, write an overlay whose value is `""` (Go treats it as the file not existing). Any other `git show` failure adds an incomplete notice.
   - Reject any path that is absolute or contains `..` before writing.
   - Return a `BriefSection` titled `Base overlays`. Per file it holds the path and a one-line plain command: `go -C WORKTREE test -overlay TMPDIR/overlay-N.json ./DIR`, built with `ShellWord`. The section says that the command runs the package's tests with only that file reverted to the base, that a test the slice added for that file should fail, and that the reviewer may add `-run NAME`. It gives the count left out past 20. It returns nil when no Go file changed.
   - Failures are advisory, like `decisionPathsSection`: the section says the check is incomplete and tells the reviewer to run `git show` itself. They never pause the run.
3. In `internal/engine/round.go`, in the `r.role == RoleReviewer` block next to `decisionPathsSection`, append the section when `baseOverlaySection(ctx, rec, tmpDir)` returns one. The gate and the architect get none.
4. In `internal/roles/prompts/reviewer.md`, add a short `## Probe tests` section. It applies only when the brief says the reviewer may write its temp directory. The recipe has three parts:
   - Write a test file with Write in `{{temp_dir}}`.
   - Write an overlay JSON `{"Replace": {"{{worktree}}/PKGDIR/probe_test.go": "{{temp_dir}}/probe_test.go"}}`.
   - Run one plain command: `go -C {{worktree}} test -overlay {{temp_dir}}/overlay.json -run TestProbe ./PKGDIR`.
   The section also says to read `## Base overlays` in the brief for the ready revert commands. Keep it ASCII, and keep the other sections of the prompt unchanged.
5. In `internal/daemon/runner.go`, delete the `if req.Role == engine.RoleSpecCheck { allowlist = append(allowlist, "Bash(adj find*)") }` block. In `internal/daemon/runner_test.go`, remove the three `Bash(adj find*)` additions (the spec-check branches in `TestReadOnlyRoleOnCloudClaudeGetsTheReadOnlyList` and `TestClaudeReadOnlyRoleArguments`).
6. Write the tests listed under Failing tests first, and see them fail. The harness fake rejects or ignores unrouted git calls, so add the `git show` routes to the new tests. Check that the existing reviewer-round harness tests still pass, because the reviewer path now makes extra git reads.
7. Update `docs/design.md`. After the `## Decision changelog paths` bullet, add a bullet for the reviewer's `## Base overlays` section: what ork writes into the reviewer's process temp dir, the 20-file cap, and that it is advisory. In the S510 paragraph, mention that the reviewer prompt carries the probe recipe.
8. Add the changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S554 --text "..."`. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.
